table_metadata.name: ICSR.PATIENT
table_metadata.description: Stores demographic details. Granularity: One row per Safety Report.

columns.name: SAFETY_REPORT_ID
columns.description: Primary Key. Use for counting distinct cases.

columns.name: PATIENT_AGE_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Coded age group. FK to PATIENT_AGE_GROUP.

columns.name: ONSET_AGE
columns.description: Raw numeric age value. Must be paired with ONSET_AGE_TI_UNIT_ID.

columns.name: ONSET_AGE_TI_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Time unit for ONSET_AGE. FK to TIME_INTERVAL.

columns.name: CREATED_ON
columns.description: Date the record was entered into the database.

special_handling.age_calculation: To filter by exact age in years, you MUST check ONSET_AGE_TI_UNIT_ID = 1 (Years). For infants/neonates, rely on PATIENT_AGE_GROUP_ID.
special_handling.null_handling: Standard NullFlavors (MSK, UNK) are handled via specific _NF_ID columns, but usually NULL in the main ID column implies missing info.
